newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says might cut overnight rate again.
newsitem.headline: Manila says might cut overnight rate again.

text.p: Philippine central bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday the overnight rates may be cut again.

Speaking to reporters after a news conference, Singson pointed to the Philippine Dealing System (PDS) which showed peso-dollar trades at 27.65, and said: "We might bring down the overnight rate again today.
The peso has strengthened substantially on Thursday after last week's de facto devaluation.
Asked if the central bank had intervened on Thursday, Singson said: "Very minimal intervention ... much smaller than yesterday."
On Wednesday the central bank sold four million dollars and bought one million.
